def transform(grid):

        runs=[]
        for i in range(n):

            if solid:
                if runs and i == runs[-1][-1] + 1: runs[-1].append(i)
                else: runs.append([i])
        return runs
    row_runs, col_runs = find_runs(0), find_runs(1)
    size = len(max(row_runs + col_runs, key=len))
    pitch = size + 1
    # 3-stripes are blank slots in the repeated motif array.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3: out[r][c] = 0
    row_stripe = {r for run in row_runs for r in run}
    col_stripe = {c for run in col_runs for c in run}
    def read_tile(r0,c0):
        if r0 < 0 or c0 < 0 or r0+size > h or c0+size > w: return None
        if any(r in row_stripe for r in range(r0,r0+size)) or any(c in col_stripe for c in range(c0,c0+size)): return None
        t=[grid[r][c0:c0+size] for r in range(r0,r0+size)]
        return t if any(v==2 for row in t for v in row) else None
    def copy_into(r0,c0,t):
        for i in range(size):
            for j in range(size): out[r0+i][c0+j]=t[i][j]
    row_starts=list(range(0,h-size+1,pitch))
    col_starts=list(range(0,w-size+1,pitch))
    # Fill missing tile row/column only at positions whose indexed motif pixel exists.
    for run in row_runs:

            chosen=None
            for r0 in row_starts:

                if t is not None and t[ti][tj] == 2:
                    chosen=t

            if chosen is not None: copy_into(target,c0,chosen)
    for run in col_runs:
        target=run[0]
        tj=target//pitch
        if tj >= size: continue
        for ti,r0 in enumerate(row_starts):
